active_objective: Couple the authoritative fixed-point native body engine to the actual native material volume so rock and sand occupancy causally create body contact before any active organism is rendered.
next_gate: Body/material coupling must pass deterministic native tests proving rock/sand support comes from material occupancy, removing material removes support, water is not faked as solid, contact remains bounded, and combined material-fluid-body replay is deterministic before WASM/render integration.
next_scientific_blocker: Native body-to-material coupling: fixed-point body v1 is real and CI-passed, but the promoted standalone slice still uses its isolated voxel contact cache and is not yet synchronized to the active material solver.
